summary: Starwood Property Trust filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $500M in 5.875% unsecured senior notes due 2029 via a private placement under Rule 144A/Regulation S. Proceeds will fund green/social projects or refinance existing 4.375% notes due 2027. Interest paid semi-annually, maturity August 15, 2029. No subsidiaries guarantee initially. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
